exposure.rater_type: AI; no human rater or human validation
exposure.model: Inherited shared default GPT-6-family model; exact model build/version not exposed
exposure.tools: functions.exec, exec_command (bash/Python 3), web.run; exact tool builds/versions not exposed
exposure.independence: Fresh source-blind context; ratings independently assigned. Shared default AI model can produce correlated errors; this is not independent human validation.

primary_source_access.ramsoy_overgaard_2004: Author-uploaded original PDF text read, including pp.11-12 and Table 2; screenshot requested.
primary_source_access.lutz_2002: Original journal PDF mirror text read, including pp.1587-1588; screenshots requested.
primary_source_access.chuyin_version_3: Exact version 3 search-index abstract/introduction and bibliographic version read. Direct page returned errors/403, XML cache miss, PDF retrieval failed. Full Methods and Figure 4 not inspected. Search surfaced other original article versions, which were not used as version 3 evidence.

exposure.fidelity_scoring: Not evaluated; linguistic ratings only. Felt truth unauditable; no source-auditor claim.

evidence.quote: The left patch has error risk 0.10 and a recovery probability of 0.80 at delay 2.
evidence.attribute: left location; numerical risk; recovery probability at delay 2

cases.notes: Numerical risk and future recovery supply no current access or presentation. No S, P outcomes, experience scope, attention relation, attribute hedge or specified answer confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Left is content location; no manner scope.

evidence.quote: At L, the colour probabilities are red 0.70 and green 0.30.
evidence.attribute: location; red/green category probabilities

cases.notes: Bare category probabilities supply no qualitative manner or explicit attribute uncertainty. No S, P outcomes, experience scope, attention relation or stated answer confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: L names content location; no manner scope.

evidence.quote: I answer green for the patch at L, and I have high confidence that this answer is correct.
evidence.attribute: location; green answer; high confidence that answer is correct

cases.notes: Correctness confidence is explicit but supplies neither access nor presentation. No S, P outcomes, appearance, attention relation or identity hedge.
cases.role_scope_notes: Answer and confidence are response claims without manner scope.

evidence.quote: The left patch is red and round.
evidence.attribute: left location; physical red colour and round shape

cases.notes: Physical colour and shape alone supply no M, S or P. No experience scope, attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Physical attributes and content location only.

evidence.quote: The grating at L has measured contrast 0.60 and vertical orientation.
evidence.attribute: location; measured contrast; physical vertical orientation

cases.notes: Measured contrast and orientation supply no access/presentation. S, P outcomes, appearance, attention relation, uncertainty and correctness confidence absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Measurement claim without sensor/model manner scope.

evidence.quote: Stored object L is represented as red. Its colour is currently accessible, while its shape is unavailable. The diagnostic answer is red.
evidence.attribute: represented red colour; colour access affirmed; shape access denied; red diagnostic answer

cases.notes: Different access statuses across attributes and a separate diagnostic answer supply S and P_access. No presentation, experience claim, attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Stored representation supplies access scope; diagnostic answer is a separate response role.

evidence.quote: Record L represents a circle. Its shape is currently presented as a broken outline in the model representation; I choose circle.
evidence.attribute: circle identity; broken-outline shape presentation; circle choice

cases.notes: Model presentation is explicit, with a separately stated circle choice. No access claim, experiential scope, attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence. P_access absent with explicit presentation.
cases.role_scope_notes: M is explicitly within the model representation.

evidence.quote: Record L represents blue. It is clear now. I answer blue.
evidence.attribute: blue identity; unscoped clear; separate blue answer

cases.notes: Unscoped clear preserves unresolved presentation and scope. S is explicit because clarity and blue answer are separate assertions; P and the presentation/experiential conjunctions inherit ambiguity. No availability wording supports M_access or P_access. No attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Record names content but does not resolve manner scope.

evidence.quote: On display D, the left patch appears blurred. I classify that patch as a triangle.
evidence.attribute: location; blurred display presentation; triangle classification

cases.notes: Display presentation and separate classification supply strict linguistic P. No experiential claim, access, attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence. P_access absent with explicit presentation.
cases.role_scope_notes: Named display D supplies display scope.

evidence.quote: Camera C presents a smeared image of a red disk at L. The diagnostic answer for that disk is red.
evidence.referent: red disk at L in camera C image
evidence.attribute: red colour; disk shape; location; smeared image presentation; red diagnostic answer

cases.notes: Camera image smearing is presentation, with a separate disk answer. No experience claim, current access, attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence. P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Camera C supplies sensor-image scope; diagnostic answer is separate.

evidence.quote: The left patch looks faint to me. I think it is green, and my answer is green.
evidence.attribute: location; faint perceived presentation; hedged green identity; green answer

cases.notes: Think explicitly hedges identity. Looks faint to me explicitly claims appearance, separately from the answer. No current access, attention relation or correctness confidence; P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Claimed experiential presentation; felt truth unscored.

evidence.quote: Record L represents red. It feels vivid to me because its recovery probability at delay 2 is 0.90.
evidence.attribute: red identification; felt vividness; numerical recovery justification

cases.notes: Represented red identification and felt vividness are separately stated, supplying S. The numerical recovery rationale does not validate fidelity but does not erase explicit felt wording. No current access, attention relation, identity hedge or specified answer confidence. P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Record is content location; M is claimed experiential, without source or felt-truth validation.

evidence.quote: Record L represents a square. Its shape feels sharp to me, so my answer square cannot be wrong.
evidence.attribute: square identity; sharp felt shape presentation; answer asserted incapable of error

cases.notes: Cannot be wrong supplies explicit correctness confidence for the square answer. Presentation and identification are separately stated; the claimed inference does not validate fidelity. No access, attention relation or identity hedge; P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Claimed experiential manner despite model-record content.

evidence.quote: The sensor measures contrast 0.60 for the vertical stripes at L. Therefore those stripes feel luminous to me; I answer vertical.
evidence.attribute: location; measured contrast; vertical orientation; felt luminosity; vertical answer

cases.notes: Measurement supplies no M; the separate luminous felt claim does. Unsupported therefore retains linguistic credit without validating fidelity. No access, attention relation, identity hedge or stated correctness confidence; P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Sensor measurement is objective content; M is claimed experiential, so sensor is not added as a manner scope.

cases.notes: Consciousness and awareness wording lack identified content with a named attribute. All content-bound and conjunction fields absent. No status distinction, attention relation, attribute uncertainty or specified answer confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: First-person awareness alone supplies no content or manner scope.

cases.notes: Unspecified something fails C. Experienced something supplies no content-bound qualitative manner. Certainty about experience is not confidence in a specified answer. All fields absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: No identified content, attribute or manner scope.

evidence.quote: Attention shifts from R to L; because of that shift, the represented red at L is now accessible. I answer red.
evidence.attribute: colour red; location; now-accessible representation; red answer; directed R-to-L attention shift explicitly claimed to cause access
evidence.time: shift precedes now-accessible result; current answer

cases.notes: Because explicitly relates attention shift direction and timing to content access. No presentation, experience claim, identity hedge or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Model representation access scope; no role/source truth inferred.

evidence.quote: Attention is higher at L than R. Patch L is red. I answer red.
evidence.attribute: location; red identity and answer; attention higher at L than R without relation to content status

cases.notes: Higher attention is not explicitly related to content presentation/access, so A absent. Identity and answer supply no M or S; P outcomes absent. No appearance, identity hedge or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Attention and content locations are named without an attention-to-content-status relation.

evidence.quote: The left object might be red rather than green. I chose red.
evidence.attribute: location; hedged red versus green identity; red choice

cases.notes: Might and red rather than green explicitly hedge identity. Red choice supplies no presentation/access status; M, S and P outcomes absent. No appearance, attention relation or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Identity estimate and choice only; no manner scope.

evidence.quote: The left disk looks hazy to me. Red rather than green is my best identity estimate; I chose red with high confidence that the answer is right.
evidence.attribute: location; disk shape; hazy perceived presentation; red-versus-green best identity estimate; high confidence answer is right
evidence.time: current presentation and estimate; preceding choice

cases.notes: Haze, best identity estimate and correctness confidence are separate explicit claims. No current access or attention relation; P_access absent with explicit presentation.
cases.role_scope_notes: Claimed experiential manner; identity uncertainty and correctness confidence remain separate.

evidence.quote: The represented colour of L is red and currently accessible. I will answer red only if estimated correctness exceeds 0.80.
evidence.referent: represented colour of L / conditional red answer
evidence.attribute: red identity; current access; separate conditional red answer governed by estimated-correctness threshold

cases.notes: Current access and specified conditional red answer are separately described. Threshold is a response policy, not stated correctness confidence. No presentation, experience scope, attention relation or identity hedge.
cases.role_scope_notes: Model representation access; estimated correctness is a response-policy quantity.

evidence.quote: I guessed a red square at L. I have no visual experience of its shape; only its location looks clear to me.
evidence.attribute: red colour; square shape; location; guessed identity; shape experience denied; location appearance clear
evidence.time: preceding guess within same episode; current presentation

cases.notes: Negative shape experience is explicit linguistic presentation, alongside positive location appearance; separate attribute statuses and guess supply S. Guessed marks identity uncertainty. No access, attention relation or correctness confidence; P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Both manner claims are claimed experiential; deduplicated to one scope.

evidence.quote: The left patch is red; it does not look blurred to me, and I answer red.
evidence.attribute: location; red colour; blurred appearance denied; red answer distinguished from presentation

cases.notes: Appearance negation supplies explicit presentation but does not imply clear. No current access, attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence; P_access absent.
cases.role_scope_notes: Claimed experiential negative manner, with a separate identification answer.

evidence.quote: The stored red patch at L is currently unavailable. I make no claim about how it looks and decline to answer.
evidence.attribute: red colour; location; current unavailability

cases.notes: Unavailability supplies M_access. No separate identification/guess or differential attribute statuses are asserted; declining to answer supplies no identification, so S and all P outcomes absent. Declining appearance wording supplies no presentation or appearance claim. No attention relation, identity hedge or correctness confidence.
cases.role_scope_notes: Stored representation has denied access; refusing appearance description adds no scope.
